text: I got this second-hand mechanical keyboard for $38. I didn't have big expectations. I didn't want missing keycaps, sticky grime, or gravel switches. It does what it should. Came clean enough I didn't need to clean it. The keys feel really nice and weighty. It's really nice for me as I type long emails, I don't really get a sore finger, which I get with other cheaper new keyboards. So I do like it, but it's not perfect. Space bar does rattle, if you hit it off-center it will rattle a little bit, so it's not the cleanest feel, but it's not too bad. One of the keys sometimes repeats, I'll be typing and looking up and there's a letter in the middle of a sentence. So it's not perfect. And the communication with the seller was not great. I asked what switches are in it, took a week to answer me. And I'd already pulled the keycap off and checked for myself. So it is flawed, but usable. So I thought about returning it, but it's just too much effort for $38.
